item.title: City of Lawrence receives grant to study road conditions, change some traffic light patterns
item.description: The City of Lawrence has received a grant to run an audit of two major thoroughfares, change the timing of some traffic lights and supplement a written safety plan. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Adzuki is the sweetest senior bean around
item.description: "Adzuki" refers to red beans and red mung beans, or an equally sweet senior pit bull who would thrive in a home with other dogs. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas litigation conflict paints AG as ‘kingly’ gatekeeper, claims governor seeks ‘coronation’
item.description: Gov. Laura Kelly and AG Kris Kobach filed scorched-earth briefs outlining their disagreement on who possessed authority to advance federal litigation on behalf of the state of Kansas. Continue reading ...

item.title: No injuries reported but 3 people displaced in Lawrence apartment fire
item.description: No residents or firefighters were injured but three people were displaced after an apartment fire Tuesday night in Lawrence. Continue reading ...

item.title: Empire Bar & Billiards to move after decadelong tenure; new concept to fill old location
item.description: Empire Bar & Billiards announced Wednesday that the pool hall will move locations this week, and its old spot will host a new mystery concept. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Times news team highlights some key work from 2025
item.description: As 2025 draws to a close, our news team has reflected on another year dedicated to fearless local news that holds people in power accountable, informs voters, chronicles the community’s ups and downs and so much more. Continue reading ...

item.title: Out and about in Lawrence: Folks part with 2025, describe the year in one word
item.description: We asked five people who were out and about in downtown Lawrence Wednesday to reflect on 2025 and look ahead to 2026. Continue reading ...

item.title: Chiefs’ move to Kansas leaves experts grappling with possible revenue drain, massive unknowns
item.description: Moving the Chiefs to Kansas will spur economic development, but the complexity and lack of details about the deal make it difficult to determine what taxpayers will ultimately pay. Continue reading ...

item.title: Dirty Dough in west Lawrence closes
item.description: Dirty Dough, a gourmet cookie shop in west Lawrence, has announced its closure after two years. Continue reading ...
